meta.description: Grows a branch from every point, for example the points of points_on_path or the kinks of trunk_kink.

plant.description: The paths the points sit on, the branches are added to them.

thickness.description: The thickness of the branches, relative to the path at the point. Above 1 a branch is thicker than its path, like a side vein whose blade reaches farther than the one of the midrib.

angle.description: Upward tilt of branches. 0 = straight out from the point, positive = upward, negative = drooping.

taper.description: How much the thickness tapers to the tip. 1 = a cone, 0 = the thickness input alone sets the profile.

resolution_curve.description: The resolution of a branch as long as the longest path, shorter branches get fewer points.
